name: Urubici
description: Uruguayan online store for bicycles, frames, drivetrain, brakes, wheels, lighting, apparel and workshop tools. Ships across Uruguay; prices in UYU.
description_es: Tienda online uruguaya de bicicletas, cuadros, transmisión, frenos, ruedas, iluminación, indumentaria y herramientas. Envía a todo Uruguay; precios en UYU.

ships_to.notes: Montevideo and nearby Canelones via its own service with neighbourhood flat rates; elsewhere by postal agency, paid on delivery

shopping_notes: Cycling parts and accessories; use category vehicles-auto-parts for components. Shipping cost is shown at checkout.

sources.supports: home page: categories, brands, UYU prices, cart
shipping page: nationwide coverage, Montevideo service, postal agency elsewhere
